stillOpen: The right-hand panel is still an *editor group*, not the reference's fixed-tab Apps panel. The reference (section 3.2 / AX rows 79-88) is one panel whose tab strip always shows Changes / Browser / Terminal / File plus `Open new tab menu`; Caret's tab strip only renders tabs that are actually open, so a fresh draft shows an empty group. Closing this needs a real feature (a fixed-tab panel part), not a copy change - a Terminal editor surface does not exist in this window at all.

`Add Tab` is core workbench copy (src/vs/workbench/browser/parts/editor/editorTabsControl.ts) shared with the IDE window, so it was not renamed to the reference's `Open new tab menu`; there is no sessions-scoped seam for that string.
The composer toolbar is still missing the reference's reasoning/effort popup (`High`). Caret has no reasoning control in this composer yet; adding one is an OMP-capability question, not copy.

The composer's first row is still `Workspace` + `Customize` chips, not the reference's project / branch / `This Mac` row. The workspace chip already takes the selected project's name, so it reads as the reference once a project is selected; the branch combo is unwired (`branchPicker.ts` is only used by the automation dialog) and needs a git source.

The sidebar still lacks the reference's Search, Projects, Repositories and Getting Started entries. `Customize` has a real command behind it (`sessions.customization.overview`) and could be lifted into the sidebar, but Projects/Repositories/Search have no surface in this window yet, and section 5 forbids shipping controls without a real capability.
The reference's idea rows with per-row `Dismiss recommendation` are still absent from the empty draft.
